description: Turn Vietnamese text typed in the old fonts (TCVN3/ABC such as .VnTime, or VNI such as VNI-Times) into Unicode, so it reads right in any font: "Céng hßa x· héi chñ nghÜa" becomes "Cộng hòa xã hội chủ nghĩa". The old font is guessed from the text unless you name it. Up to 5,000 characters a call. Free. For a whole Word or Excel file, send the user to https://yangopen.com/vi/tools/font-to-unicode/.

font.description: The old font's table: tcvn3 (.VnTime and the other .Vn fonts), tcvn3-upper (.VnTimeH and the other fonts ending in H, all capitals), vni (VNI-Times and the other VNI fonts), or auto (guess). Default auto.

text.description: The text as it looks now, copied from the document.

name: convert_vietnamese_font
title: Fix Vietnamese text typed in the old fonts (TCVN3, VNI)
